details:
Many VRChat worlds include achievement systems, but those achievements are often isolated to the individual world. It would be great to have an API or official profile integration that allows players to showcase their achievements across multiple worlds in one place.

For example, players could add a link to their VRChat bio that opens a web-based profile page displaying every participating world they've earned achievements in, along with the specific achievements they've unlocked. The page could also track a cumulative achievement score based on their total accomplishments across all supported worlds.

To prevent spam, abuse, or low-quality achievement systems from flooding the platform, world creators would need to apply for inclusion before their achievements could contribute to player profiles.

This could provide several benefits. Players would gain a fun, long-term progression system that encourages exploration and gives them goals to pursue when they're looking for something new to do. At the same time, world creators would benefit from increased visibility and engagement, as players seek out worlds to expand their achievement collections and improve their overall score.

Ultimately, it would create a platform-wide achievement ecosystem that rewards player activity, encourages world discovery, and gives users a meaningful way to showcase their accomplishments throughout VRChat.
title: Achievements!
